reviews.title: Blazing fast, easy to install, worth the performance.
reviews.comment: I purchased this RAM as an upgrade to my existing 16GB of T-Create Expert RAM. My system did not like the configuration of the RAM when I first installed it, so I rearranged the channels they were installed in and everything worked perfectly. After install I am sporting 48GB of the T-Create Expert RAM at 6000 MHz and it absolutely does not disappoint. I purchased this to ensure that I could optimally run Oblivion Remastered while multi-tasking and so far it hasn't putt a dent in it. Very much worth the price point for the performance I received.
